text:
Tara Nguyen: Quick sync — I put together a short list of telemetry fields we need for the queue-shaping + kernel-selection dashboard. Want to hand off to Observability next week.

Tara Nguyen: Core metrics: batch_utilization, queue_depth_by_priority, tokens_per_sec (system + per-model), kv_cache_hitrate, kernel_choice_counts, stall_duration_ms, microburst_events. Also sample traces for bad tail latency.

Matt Li: SGTM. Do we also want a moving token budget target per GPU? would help autotuner.

Tara Nguyen: yes — token_budget_target (per-queue, rolling 1m/5m), plus a flag for applied_policy (e.g. drop-oldest, size-cap, priority-siphon).

Jin Park: For kernel_choice_counts: can we tag by model_arch and seq_len_bucket? otherwise it's noisy.

Tara Nguyen: agreed. add labels: model, arch, seq_len_bucket, hw_type (A100/V100/rd-ma).

Sofia Alvarez: can Observability expose a single panel that shows the effect of a kernel switch? want before/after of tokens/sec and stall_duration_ms.

Matt Li: we'll need an event marker emitted when kernel selection changes. propose emitting `kernel.switch` event with old/new and reason. quick proto: 
```
counter{event="kernel.switch",old="gemm_v1",new="systolic_v2",reason="seq>512"}
```

Tara Nguyen: perfect. also emit `batch.formation` events for dropped requests and `kv.hitrate.sample` every 30s (percent + sample_count).

deploy-bot: alert: continuous-batcher/node-12 observed 4 stall_events in 5m (avg stall_duration 120ms). <https://infra.reports/issue/523|view> :warning:

Jin Park: that deploy-bot alert matches the trace I pulled — KV cache hit-rate fell to 12% and we were falling back to cold loads. looks like cache eviction policy interacting with microbursts.

Tara Nguyen: action items: 1) Observability: add panels for the metrics above + event overlays (kernel.switch, batch.formation), 2) Runtime: emit kernel.switch & batch.formation events + kv.hitrate.sample, 3) SRE: run a 2hr experiment toggling `priority-siphon` policy to see queue depth differences.

Sofia Alvarez: I'll create the dashboard skeleton and share a link for review by EOD Thurs.

Matt Li: I'll add the event telemetry in runtime PR (will @jin for review).

Jin Park: will instrument kv.hitrate.sample and seq_len_bucket tagging. also will attach a short runbook for interpreting the panels.

Tara Nguyen: thanks — can we have a follow-up sync Fri 10am PT? I'd like a first-pass dashboard + sample traces ready.

Sofia Alvarez: ✅ added to calendar.

Matt Li: posting sketch for PromQL we can use: 
```
# batch utilization per node
sum(rate(batch_tokens_total[1m])) by (node) / sum(node_max_throughput) by (node)

# kv hitrate sampled
sum(rate(kv_hitrate_hits[30s])) / sum(rate(kv_hitrate_total[30s]))
```

Tara Nguyen: awesome. please drop links to PRs/dashboards here when ready.

Sofia Alvarez: link to draft: <https://dashboards.internal/redwood/queueflow-draft|queueflow draft>

Jin Park: noted — I'll attach sample traces to the dashboard.

Tara Nguyen: thanks everyone, closing the loop for now.
